about_heading: Two generations of dentists, one practice
about_body:
The Grove Family Dental is run by Dr. Todd Garrett and Dr. Brady Garrett, a father and son practicing together in Glendale. General, cosmetic and implant care all sit under one roof.

The practice now works from an office built from the ground up for it, so families can see the same team for routine visits, cosmetic treatment and implants without being sent across town.

services.blurb: Replacing missing teeth with implants placed and restored by the same team.
